sections.heading: About this edition
paragraphs: This is Benjamin Jowett's English translation of Plato's Republic, via Project Gutenberg ebook #1497.

Navigation is by Book only (10 total). Unlike the accompanying Greek text (data/plato-republic-grc) and every other work in this importer group, this source carries NO Stephanus page markers at all - Gutenberg's plain-text transcription of Jowett's translation was never marked up with them, so there is no page-level citation data to preserve. The Greek edition, sourced from Perseus/Open Greek and Latin (which does carry Stephanus TEI markup), offers page-level navigation that this English edition genuinely cannot.

Jowett's own "Introduction and Analysis" essay, which precedes the dialogue proper in the printed edition and includes his own prose summary of each Book, is not included here - only the dialogue itself.
